prompt_instructions: Attach the original image to preserve the ambassador's identity and exact facial details.
Keep all Vietnamese text, accents, prices, percentages, and brand names exactly as shown.
Maintain the exaggerated large-head advertising treatment and crossed-arm pose.
Preserve the bright-yellow outer border and blue-to-mint gradient background.
Do not remove or replace the BADASS product images, voucher panels, or marketplace branding.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: Create a high-quality vertical 4:5 Vietnamese e-commerce campaign poster for BADASS. Use a bright-yellow outer border around a smooth sky-blue-to-pale-mint gradient background. At the top, place the white branding lockup 'BADASS | Shopee Mall | TikTok Shop'. Add an oversized curved yellow headline 'BÃO SALE' with a thick white outline and soft shadow, followed by 'THÁNG 7' in the same bold playful style. In the middle-left area, add overlapping angled banners reading 'MUA CÀNG NHIỀU' in royal blue on yellow and 'GIẢM CÀNG SÂU' in white on royal blue. On the right, feature an adult Vietnamese male ambassador wearing a beige polo shirt and dark wristwatch, standing with arms crossed. Give him an intentionally enlarged head, subtle pink blush on both cheeks, and small white sparkle accents. In the lower-left area, place a rounded translucent product card containing a black BADASS Slow Fashion shopping bag and dark gray boxer briefs, followed by the text 'QUÀ TẶNG HẤP DẪN' and 'CHO ĐƠN 499K, 599K'. At the bottom, add two cream ticket-shaped promotional panels: the left reads 'VOUCHER GIẢM SÂU ĐẾN 50K' and the right reads 'GIẢM ĐẾN 50% SẢN PHẨM'. Use bold rounded sans-serif typography, strong blue-yellow contrast, crisp product presentation, bright studio lighting, playful celebrity advertising, and polished social-commerce art direction.
